messages:
sam_backend: seeing intermittent 503s from embeds-prod-eu since 02:45 UTC. traces point to header parser re-entry + kvcache pressure. built image fix-2026-hotfix. requesting expedited deploy with micro-canary (1%). need ops + sre.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: service=embeds-prod-eu image=fix-2026-hotfix requester=sam_backend. Default canary=10%. To set micro-canary use `--canary 1`. Approvals required: 2 (ops, sre). Approve with `/approve deploy 1768005432` or react :white_check_mark:.

tara_sre: prefer micro-canary 1% + 5m observation. please post prometheus snapshot and confirm no migrations.

mike_ops: will sign off if rollback image provided + quick rollback steps here. i'll be on pager for 60m.

sam_backend: rollback image set to fix-2025-stable. no DB or config changes. rollback snippet: `deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image fix-2025-stable && deployctl wait --stable embeds-prod-eu`. runbook: https://playbooks/internal/embeds-rollback-1768005432

paul_pm: product approves expedited micro-canary. impact: medium for EU batch customers.

release-bot: Draft release note: "hotfix(embeds): fix header parser loop causing intermittent 503s in EU (fix-2026-hotfix)" edit at https://internal/releases/1768005432

tara_sre: /approve deploy 1768005432  approving conditioned on 1% canary + 5m soak.

mike_ops: /approve deploy 1768005432  approving. pager on. rollback command ready.

deploy-bot: Approvals received (2). Initiating rollout: canary=1% -> observe=5m -> promote. Command: `deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image fix-2026-hotfix --canary 1 --timeout 5m --requester sam_backend`

deploy-bot: Canary started. Pod: embeds-fix-2026-1 (Ready). telemetry: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/1768005432-canary

deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 5m: errors=0, p99 within baseline, kvcache misses normalized. Promoting to 100% per policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment SUCCESS. Release page: https://deployments.redwood/1768005432

sam_backend: thanks folks. i'll monitor dashboards for 45m then close thread if stable. great turnaround :tada:
